direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh at 1366x768, overflow hidden; rows 48px header / 40px compact horizontal rail / minmax(0,1fr) main / 56px action bar; horizontal rail only with equal-width non-wrapping targets, aria-current and arrow-key movement; rendered scene at least 70% of main with independent reserved zones for callouts, stations and jobs, no overlap and no side-zone scrolling
direction.colorTokens: Entirely black, emerald green and brushed silver: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, border rgba(197,204,212,.22); brushed silver #C5CCD4 headings and machine bodies, dim silver rgba(197,204,212,.68) secondary text; emerald/neon #A8F04A sole accent and primary fill with #050705 text, one primary per viewport; stopped states silver cross-hatching, x cross marker and plain OFFLINE text; official logo immutable in black, emerald/neon green and brushed silver at native aspect in exactly two placements: header and opening story
direction.typography: System sans; 16px/24 body minimum, no label under 12px; header tabs span most of header with labels at least 16px; 24/30 stage title, 18/24 panel title, 12/16 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration
direction.motion: Living material flow, state glow, depth and cinematic 240ms route trace on real state change then static; 160-220ms ease-out selection and panels; preserve these features with prefers-reduced-motion removing transitions and flow while silver pattern, cross marker and OFFLINE text carry meaning; 2px emerald focus ring with 2px offset; pointer style only on enabled controls
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo left and Lock recovery room right; opening story carries second required logo placement; compact horizontal rail from one steps array; focusable cinematic factory SVG dominant; side zone keeps connection readiness checking provider identity separate from investigation evidence task under separate headings, status and controls; action bar 56px Back left, status centre, one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens one-click Approve then the Authorize this decision wall; pending task proposal deliberately untracked until human approval; blocked prior tasks and an approved recovery plan can coexist while replacement tasks await approval; tab order skip-to-stage, header, rail, SVG nodes, side zone, action bar; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite
